description: This file is a shell script containing test cases for verifying git blob and diff operations, including creation, comparison, and checking differences using various git commands.

methods.name: run_diff
methods.description: Executes a git diff command with the full index option and saves the output to a diff file.

methods.name: check_index
methods.description: Checks that the diff output contains the expected index line for given sha1s.

methods.name: check_mode
methods.description: Verifies that the diff output shows the expected mode changes.

methods.name: check_paths
methods.description: Checks that the diff output references the expected file paths.
